_about: Pictures for residents' traits (ResidentTraitDefinition) and raid marks (MarkDefinition), keyed by id, for Tools/LocalSpawn/generate_item_icons.py --set traits, painted whole in the skill icons' dark style (UX pass 2026-11-28: every trait card showed the same small hammer glyph). Traits: one clear object or small scene that is the person's habit, warm firelight. Marks: what the raid left on them, colder light, worn and scarred. Centred, readable small.
bookish: An open old book with runes and herb sketches beside a lit candle and a small glass vial, warm candlelight
born_leader: A raised war horn bound in iron with a red banner behind it, warm torchlight
brave: A battered round shield held forward, an axe behind it, sparks flying, warm firelight
early_riser: A rooster on a fence post against a pale gold dawn over misty hills
hammer_gruff: A heavy smith's hammer slammed on an anvil, a frowning brow of soot, warm forge light
kind: Two hands cupping a small warm flame, soft golden light
light_sleeper: A half-open eye over a straw pillow, a lantern burning low, dim night light
loner: A lone hooded figure on a rock above a misty forest, a small campfire, dusk
night_eyes: A pair of pale glowing eyes in the dark forest at night, silver moonlight
opinionated: A wooden scaffold with a mallet pointing at a carpenter's plumb line, warm light
patient_hands: Careful hands polishing a fine sword blade with a cloth on a workbench, warm lamplight
proud_cook: A steaming iron pot of stew over a hearth with a long wooden ladle, warm firelight
secretive: A small locked wooden box with a glowing potion bottle inside, shadows, a finger to lips silhouette
seed_keeper: A cloth pouch spilling seeds into an open palm, a green sprout among them, warm light
sharp_tongued: A sharp knife beside a frothing ale mug on a tavern table, warm firelight
steadfast: A tall planted spear and a shield braced against a stone wall in a storm, firm stance, warm light
tireless: A smith's hammer resting on an anvil under a lantern late at night, embers still glowing
wary: A half-drawn dagger and a watching eye through tall grass, dim cautious light
afraid_of_widows: Long black spider legs reaching out of darkness, a trembling torch, cold sickly light
defended_the_ward: A cracked glowing ward stone with a sword planted before it, pale blue light, scarred
forest_touched: A face half covered in moss and small roots, eyes glowing faint green, misty forest
giant_felled: An enormous fallen troll hand on the ground beside a small dented shield, dust in the air
lost_in_the_mire: A boot sinking in black marsh water with pale reeds and mist, cold grey light
mist_walker: A lantern held up into thick pale mist, a faint path of footprints, silver light
nightmares: A twisted dark shape looming over a rumpled bed, cold blue night light
night_terrors: Clawed shadow hands reaching from violet corrupted mist toward a sleeper, dark
old_wound: A bandaged arm with an old dark stain, a broken arrow shaft beside it, cold muted light
spider_bane: A cut black spider leg pinned under a dagger, pale gold light
steady_hands: A calm hand holding a drawn bowstring perfectly still, soft clear light
troll_wary: A heavy axe resting against a great mossy troll skull, cold grey light
